chunks.text: NovaCRM guarantees a 99.9% uptime SLA for all Growth and Enterprise tier customers.
Priority 1 issues are responded to within 1 hour. Standard tickets within 24 hours.
All customer lead records and transcripts are encrypted using AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.

All customer data, CRM contact lists, and call records are securely hosted in tier-4 Indian data centers located in Mumbai and Hyderabad, compliant with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act and GDPR standards.
All data is protected using AES-256 bit encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 encryption in transit. Database backups are taken daily and stored in immutable, air-gapped storage.

NovaCRM utilizes private API endpoints for conversational AI processing. Customer conversations, customer names, telephone numbers, and CRM records are NEVER used to train public AI foundation models or shared with third parties.
Customers retain 100% ownership of their data. You can export complete lead records to CSV/JSON at any time or request immediate permanent data erasure by emailing privacy@novacrm.com.

NovaCRM offers a full 100% money-back guarantee within 14 days of your initial monthly or annual subscription purchase. If you are unsatisfied for any reason, submit a cancellation request to receive a complete refund.

For annual plans cancelled after the initial 14-day window but within 30 days of renewal, a pro-rated refund will be calculated based on unused remaining months, minus a 10% administrative processing fee.
To request a cancellation or refund, email billing@novacrm.com with your account ID and company name. All refunds are processed back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.
Custom API implementation services, dedicated on-site training sessions, and third-party telephony toll charges are non-refundable once delivered.
NovaCRM provides cloud-based sales pipeline and lead qualification automation. All plans are billed in Indian Rupees (₹ / INR).

- Price: ₹1,999 per user per month (or ₹19,990 annually).
- Included Features:
  - Lead and contact management for up to 5 users.
  - Single sales pipeline view with deal stages.
  - Email tracking and activity timeline.
  - Mobile app access on Android and iOS.

- Price: ₹4,999 per user per month.
- Included Features:
  - Multi-pipeline management for up to 25 users.
  - Automated WhatsApp and email follow-up sequences.
  - Inbuilt telephony and call recording integration.
  - Custom lead qualification scoring rules.
  - Standard support via email and chat.

- Price: ₹9,999 per user per month (custom volume discounts available for teams > 50 users).
- Included Features:
  - Unlimited sales pipelines and custom workflows.
  - Single Sign-On (SSO) and role-based permissions (RBAC).
  - Dedicated customer success manager.
  - 99.9% uptime Service Level Agreement (SLA).
  - Custom ERP and SAP data sync connectors.
